scope: 2026/27 archived quote period 24 October–4 November only; not the entire season
probabilities: 50% reconstructed historical candidate +50% same market reference as earlier replay
combo_prices: Unchanged estimates from previous engine; not recalculated to favor a candidate. Real quotes for base markets.
historical_availability: Candidate forecasts are ex-post event-time reconstructions, not original archived predictions. Raw results assumed available kickoff+2h.
selection: Each policy chooses highest estimated joint probability without using outcomes; no rule chosen because it wins current-period tickets.
development: Candidate parameters fixed in previous historical study; goals4 was selected on 2024, Elo20 and xG25 are fixed controls.
out_of_sample: Current period already inspected extensively; this is exploratory and cannot prove independent validation.
